newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian airports make small profit - Antara.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian airports make small profit - Antara.

text.p: Indonesia's state-owned airport management company PT Angkasa Pura II recorded a total profit of 98 billion rupiah in 1995, the official Antara news agency reported on Saturday.

Jakarta's Sukarno-Hatta and Halim Perdanakusama airports and Medan's Polonia airport were the only profit earners out of the eight airports managed by the company, it quoted finance director M. Firdaus as saying.
He said the other five airports managed by the company "are still operating without profit and even have not reached their break-even point".
